fullPassage: From the earliest times, healthcare services have been recognized to have two equal aspects, namely clinical care and public healthcare. In classical Greek mythology, the god of medicine, Asklepios, had two daughters, Hygiea and Panacea. The former was the goddess of preventive health and wellness, or hygiene, and the latter the goddess of treatment and curing. In modern times, the societal ascendancy of medical professionalism has caused treatment of sick patients to overshadow those preventive healthcare services provided by the less heroic figures of sanitary engineers, biologists, and governmental public health officers. Nevertheless, the quality of health that human populations enjoy is attributable less to surgical dexterity, innovative pharmaceutical products, and bioengineered devices than to the availability of public sanitation, sewage management, and services which control the pollution of the air, drinking water, urban noise, and food for human consumption. The human right to the highest attainable standard of health depends on public healthcare services no less than on the skills and equipment of doctors and hospitals.

✅ ③ no less than on the skills and equipment of doctors and hospitals
(의사와 병원의 기술과 장비에 못지않게)
→ 근거: 'depends on public healthcare services no less than on the skills and equipment of doctors and hospitals' ←정답

(혁신적 생명공학 장치가 보완될 때만)
→ 본문: 생명공학 장치는 건강의 질에 덜 기인하는 쪽으로 분류.

det.analysis:

→ 근거: 'the god of medicine, Asklepios, had two daughters, Hygiea and Panacea. The former was the goddess of preventive health... and the latter the goddess of treatment and curing' ←정답

→ 본문: 역할이 뒤바뀜. Hygiea = 예방/위생, Panacea = 치료/완치.

→ 본문: 방향 반대. 치료가 예방을 가린 것(treatment overshadow preventive).

❌ ④ 공중보건 서비스 제공자들은 의사보다 더 영웅적인 인물로 대우받고 있다.
→ 본문: 'less heroic figures' — 덜 영웅적으로 여겨진다.
det.tip: the former(Hygiea) = 예방, the latter(Panacea) = 치료. 역할 혼동 주의.

In classical Greek mythology, the god of medicine, Asklepios, had two daughters, Hygiea and Panacea. The former was the goddess of preventive health and wellness, or hygiene, and the latter the goddess of treatment and curing. In modern times, the societal ascendancy of medical professionalism has caused treatment of sick patients to overshadow those preventive healthcare services provided by the less heroic figures of sanitary engineers, biologists, and governmental public health officers. Nevertheless, the quality of health that human populations enjoy is attributable less to surgical dexterity, innovative pharmaceutical products, and bioengineered devices than to the availability of public sanitation, sewage management, and services which control the pollution of the air, drinking water, urban noise, and food for human consumption. The human right to the highest attainable standard of health depends on public healthcare services no less than on the skills and equipment of doctors and hospitals.
questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: 건강의 질 = 공중 위생(sanitation) + 하수 관리(sewage management)에 더 기인.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 현대 의료에서 예방 서비스가 환자 치료보다 더 주목받고 있다.
→ 본문: 치료가 예방을 가림(overshadow). 주목받는 것은 치료 쪽.

❌ ② 그리스 신화에서 Panacea는 예방적 건강과 웰빙의 여신이었다.
→ 본문: Panacea = 치료/완치의 여신. 예방/위생 = Hygiea.

✅ ③ 인류의 건강의 질은 공중 위생과 하수 관리 같은 공중보건 인프라에 더 크게 기인한다.
→ 근거: 'attributable less to surgical dexterity... than to the availability of public sanitation, sewage management' ←정답

❌ ④ 생명공학 장치는 공중 위생보다 건강의 질에 더 큰 기여를 한다.
→ 본문: 생명공학 장치는 공중 위생보다 건강에 덜 기인하는 쪽으로 분류.
det.tip: less to A than to B = A보다 B에 더 기인. 공중보건 인프라 > 의료 기술.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① the mythological origins of healthcare traditions
(의료 전통의 신화적 기원)
→ 그리스 신화는 도입부 예시. 글 전체 주제 아님.

→ 외과 기술은 건강에 덜 기인하는 항목으로만 언급.

✅ ④ the undervalued significance of public healthcare in promoting overall health
(전체 건강 증진에서 저평가된 공중보건의 중요성)
→ 근거: 치료에 가려져 있지만(overshadow) 실제 건강의 질은 공중보건에 더 기인. ←정답

det.korean: less heroic figures = 위생 기술자·생물학자·공중보건 담당관 — 의사보다 덜 주목받지만 실질적 기여자.
det.analysis:

→ 근거: 위생 기술자·생물학자·공중보건 담당관은 의사보다 '덜 영웅적'으로 여겨지지만, 건강의 질은 이들이 제공하는 공중보건 서비스에 더 기인. ←정답

→ less heroic figures = 현대의 위생 기술자 등. 신화의 신이 아님.

det.tip: heroic = 영웅적인. less heroic = 사회적으로 덜 영웅시되는(= 덜 주목받는). 능력과 무관.
